Package com.agrialert.ui.alerts

Class SetAlertsFragment

java.lang.Object
androidx.fragment.app.Fragment
com.agrialert.ui.alerts.SetAlertsFragment
All Implemented Interfaces:
android.content.ComponentCallbacks, android.view.View.OnCreateContextMenuListener, androidx.activity.result.ActivityResultCaller, androidx.lifecycle.HasDefaultViewModelProviderFactory, androidx.lifecycle.LifecycleOwner, androidx.lifecycle.ViewModelStoreOwner, androidx.savedstate.SavedStateRegistryOwner
public class SetAlertsFragment extends androidx.fragment.app.Fragment
Fragment for configuring alert settings for a specific agricultural field. Allows users to enable/disable different alert types and set custom threshold values.
